adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb the new table defines topic_id and post_id but only adds a unique index on :embed_url. There is no index on :topic_id or :post_id (so lookups like TopicEmbed.where(topic_id: ...) / embed.post can be less efficient), and there are no foreign key constraints shown to prevent orphans on topic/post deletion.
